create.name: Russell Delman
create.bio:
Russell Delman is a meditation and awareness teacher who, with his wife Linda Delman, leads The Embodied Life School. His own search began in 1970 while he was studying psychology, and over the following years he trained in Gestalt work and yoga, sat in Zen practice for more than five decades, and studied directly with Moshe Feldenkrais from 1975. He became one of the first trainers of Feldenkrais teachers in 1984 and has since helped train thousands of practitioners worldwide; he was also a close student and friend of Eugene Gendlin, who developed Focusing.

In 1993 he drew these strands together as The Embodied Life, an approach that combines Zen-based sitting, Feldenkrais movement lessons, Focusing, attention to space and guided inquiry, so that body, feeling and awareness are explored together. He and Linda teach seminars and residential retreats, mostly in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, run a three-year mentorship programme in six week-long residential segments, and offer Zoom seminars. Russell also holds short one-to-one Guided Conversations, which he describes as neither therapy nor coaching. Their shared channel carries many of his guided meditations and short talks, and their store offers recordings and booklets.

courses.title: Guided Conversations with Russell Delman
courses.description: Thirty-minute one-to-one sessions in which Russell listens and inquires with you into a subject you choose, drawing on Focusing and compassionate communication. Most people book between one and a handful.
